name: Soraki Haruto
source:
Haruto Soraki (formerly Haruto Mikami) is the protagonist of the game. After receiving recurring dreams of a promise made 7 years ago with an strangely familiar girl, Haruto returns to his hometown, from Tokyo, in search of answers to his dreams.

[Source: https://7-years-from-now.fandom.com/wiki/Haruto_Soraki]
